# truenas_vm_device (Resource)

Manages a virtual machine device. Set exactly one device type under `attributes`. Display passwords are write-only. Most device changes require the VM to be stopped.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `attributes` (Attributes) Device-specific configuration attributes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attributes))
- `vm` (Number) ID of the virtual machine this device belongs to.

### Optional

- `attributes_wo_version` (Number) Change this value to send `attributes` again. Terraform never stores `attributes`.
- `order` (Number) Boot order priority for this device. `null` for automatic assignment.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Identifier assigned by TrueNAS.

<a id="nestedatt--attributes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attributes`

Optional:

- `cdrom` (Attributes) Settings when `dtype` is `CDROM`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attributes--cdrom))
- `disk` (Attributes) Settings when `dtype` is `DISK`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attributes--disk))
- `display` (Attributes) Settings when `dtype` is `DISPLAY`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attributes--display))
- `nic` (Attributes) Settings when `dtype` is `NIC`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attributes--nic))
- `pci` (Attributes) Settings when `dtype` is `PCI`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attributes--pci))
- `raw` (Attributes) Settings when `dtype` is `RAW`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attributes--raw))
- `usb` (Attributes) Settings when `dtype` is `USB`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attributes--usb))

<a id="nestedatt--attributes--cdrom"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attributes.cdrom`

Required:

- `path` (String) Path must not contain "{", "}" characters, and it should start with "/mnt/".


<a id="nestedatt--attributes--disk"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attributes.disk`

Optional:

- `create_zvol` (Boolean) Whether to create a new ZFS volume for this disk. Defaults to `false`.
- `iotype` (String) I/O backend type for disk operations. Defaults to `"THREADS"`.
- `logical_sectorsize` (Number) Logical sector size for the disk. `null` for default.
- `path` (String) Path to existing disk file or ZFS volume. `null` if creating a new ZFS volume.
- `physical_sectorsize` (Number) Physical sector size for the disk. `null` for default.
- `serial` (String) Serial number to assign to the virtual disk. `null` for auto-generated.
- `type` (String) Disk controller interface type. AHCI for compatibility, VIRTIO for performance. Defaults to `"AHCI"`.
- `zvol_name` (String) Name for the new ZFS volume. Required if `create_zvol` is true.
- `zvol_volsize` (Number) Size of the new ZFS volume in bytes. Required if `create_zvol` is true.


<a id="nestedatt--attributes--display"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attributes.display`

Optional:

- `bind` (String) IP address to bind the display server to. Defaults to `"127.0.0.1"`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password for display server authentication.
- `port` (Number) VNC/SPICE port number for remote display access. `null` for auto-assignment.
- `resolution` (String) Screen resolution for the virtual display. Defaults to `"1024x768"`.
- `type` (String) Display protocol type. Defaults to `"SPICE"`.
- `wait` (Boolean) Whether to wait for a client connection before starting the VM. Defaults to `false`.
- `web` (Boolean) Whether to enable web-based display access. Defaults to `true`.
- `web_port` (Number) Web-based display access port number. `null` for auto-assignment.


<a id="nestedatt--attributes--nic"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attributes.nic`

Optional:

- `mac` (String) MAC address for the virtual network interface. `null` for auto-generation.
- `nic_attach` (String) Host network interface or bridge to attach to. `null` for no attachment.
- `trust_guest_rx_filters` (Boolean) Whether to trust guest OS receive filter settings for better performance. Defaults to `false`.
- `type` (String) Network interface controller type. `E1000` for Intel compatibility, `VIRTIO` for performance. Defaults to `"E1000"`.


<a id="nestedatt--attributes--pci"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attributes.pci`

Required:

- `pptdev` (String) Host PCI device identifier to pass through to the VM.


<a id="nestedatt--attributes--raw"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attributes.raw`

Required:

- `path` (String) Path must not contain "{", "}" characters.

Optional:

- `boot` (Boolean) Whether this disk should be marked as bootable. Defaults to `false`.
- `exists` (Boolean) Whether the disk file already exists or should be created. Defaults to `false`.
- `iotype` (String) I/O backend type for disk operations. Defaults to `"THREADS"`.
- `logical_sectorsize` (Number) Logical sector size for the disk. `null` for default.
- `physical_sectorsize` (Number) Physical sector size for the disk. `null` for default.
- `serial` (String) Serial number to assign to the virtual disk. `null` for auto-generated.
- `size` (Number) Size of the disk in bytes. Required if creating a new disk file.
- `type` (String) Disk controller interface type. AHCI for compatibility, VIRTIO for performance. Defaults to `"AHCI"`.


<a id="nestedatt--attributes--usb"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attributes.usb`

Optional:

- `controller_type` (String) USB controller type for the virtual machine. Defaults to `"nec-xhci"`.
- `device` (String) Host USB device path to pass through. `null` for controller only.
- `usb` (Attributes) USB device attributes for identification. `null` for USB host controller only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attributes--usb--usb))

<a id="nestedatt--attributes--usb--usb"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attributes.usb.usb`

Required:

- `product_id` (String) USB product identifier in hexadecimal format (e.g., '0x0002' for 2.0 root hub).
- `vendor_id` (String) USB vendor identifier in hexadecimal format (e.g., '0x1d6b' for Linux Foundation).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to       = truenas_vm_device.example
  provider = truenas
  identity = {
    id = 1
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (Number) Identifier assigned by TrueNAS.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by TrueNAS id
terraform import truenas_vm_device.example 1
```
